arxiv-1902-07416.title: On AKKT optimality conditions for cone-constrained vector optimization problems Thanks: ∗ Corresponding. Thanks: The research of Nguyen Van Tuyen was supported by the Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam [grant number B2018-SP2-14] as well as the grant from School of Mathematical Sciences,
arxiv-1902-07416.creator: Nguyen Van Tuyen, Yi-Bin Xiao, Ta Quang Son ∗
arxiv-1902-07416.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a kind of approximate Karush–Kuhn–Tucker condition (AKKT) for a smooth cone-constrained vector optimization problem. We show that, without any constraint qualification, the AKKT condition is a necessary for a local weak efficient solution of the considered problem.

arxiv-2011-07683.title: Hypergraph Partitioning using Tensor Eigenvalue Decomposition
arxiv-2011-07683.creator: Deepak Maurya,
arxiv-2011-07683.description: Abstract Abstract Hypergraphs have gained increasing attention in the machine learning community lately due to their superiority over graphs in capturing super-dyadic interactions among entities. In this work, we propose a novel approach for the partitioning of k -uniform hypergraphs. Most of the existing methods work by reducing the hypergraph to a graph followed by applying standard graph partitioning algorithms.

arxiv-2103-15288.title: Sharp bounds on the zeroth-order general Randić index of trees in terms of domination number This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [61773020] and Postgraduate Scientific Research Innovation Project of Hunan Province [CX20200033]. Corresponding author: Jianping L
arxiv-2103-15288.creator: Chang Liu, Jianping Li
arxiv-2103-15288.description: Abstract The zeroth-order general Randić index of graph G = ( V G , E G ) G=(V_{G},E_{G}) , denoted by R α 0 ​ ( G ) {}^{0}R_{\alpha}(G) , is the sum of items ( d v ) α (d_{v})^{\alpha} over all vertices v ∈ V G v\in V_{G} , where α \alpha is a pertinently chosen real number.

arxiv-2106-03062.title: On Training Sample Memorization: Lessons from Benchmarking Generative Modeling with a Large-scale Competition Conference: Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2021; Virtual Event, Singapore Proceedings of the 27th ACM SIGKDD Conference o
arxiv-2106-03062.creator: Ching-Yuan Bai, Hsuan-Tien Lin, Colin Raffel, Wendy Chih-wen Kan
arxiv-2106-03062.description: Abstract . Many recent developments on generative models for natural images have relied on heuristically-motivated metrics that can be easily gamed by memorizing a small sample from the true distribution or training a model directly to improve the metric. In this work, we critically evaluate the gameability of these metrics by designing and deploying a generative modeling competition.

arxiv-2205-02771.title: Finding Bipartite Components in Hypergraphs A preliminary version of this work appeared at NeurIPS 2021. This work is supported by a Langmuir PhD Scholarship, and an EPSRC Early Career Fellowship (EP/T00729X/1).
arxiv-2205-02771.creator: Peter Macgregor, He Sun
arxiv-2205-02771.description: Abstract Hypergraphs are important objects to model ternary or higher-order relations of objects, and have a number of applications in analysing many complex datasets occurring in practice. In this work we study a new heat diffusion process in hypergraphs, and employ this process to design a polynomial-time algorithm that approximately finds bipartite components in a hypergraph.

arxiv-2205-12514.title: Machine Translation Robustness to Natural Asemantic Variation
arxiv-2205-12514.creator: Jacob Bremerman Xiang Ren Jonathan May
arxiv-2205-12514.description: Abstract Current Machine Translation (MT) models still struggle with more challenging input, such as noisy data and tail-end words and phrases. Several works have addressed this robustness issue by identifying specific categories of noise and variation then tuning models to perform better on them. An important yet under-studied category involves minor variations in nuance (non-typos) that preserve meaning w.r.t.

arxiv-2207-06984.title: Second-order correlations and purity of unheralded single photons from spontaneous parametric down-conversion
arxiv-2207-06984.creator: A. Padhye, K. Muhammed Shafi, C. M. Chandrashekar
arxiv-2207-06984.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. Padhye, K. Muhammed Shafi, C. M. Chandrashekar. Various quantum technology applications require high-purity single photons with high generation rate. Although different methods are employed to generate such photons, heralded single photons from spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is the most commonly used approach. Photon generation rate from the heralded single-photon sources are limited by the efficiency of the detectors to record coincidence detection of the photon pairs which are lower than the single-photon counts recorded separately on each detector.

arxiv-2304-13287.title: ESPT: A Self-Supervised Episodic Spatial Pretext Task for Improving Few-Shot Learning
arxiv-2304-13287.creator: Yi Rong, Xiongbo Lu, Zhaoyang Sun, Yaxiong Chen, Shengwu Xiong
arxiv-2304-13287.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) techniques have recently been integrated into the few-shot learning (FSL) framework and have shown promising results in improving the few-shot image classification performance. However, existing SSL approaches used in FSL typically seek the supervision signals from the global embedding of every single image.

arxiv-2403-14862.title: The Power of Linear Programming in Sponsored Listings Ranking: Evidence from Field Experiments
arxiv-2403-14862.creator: Haihao Lu, Luyang Zhang, Yuting Zhu
arxiv-2403-14862.description: Abstract Sponsored listing is one of the major revenue sources for many prominent online marketplaces, such as Amazon, Walmart, and Alibaba. When consumers visit a marketplace’s webpage for a specific item, in addition to that item, the marketplace might also display a ranked listing of sponsored items from various third-party sellers.

arxiv-2404-08745.title: Extended Metal-Insulator Crossover with Strong Antiferromagnetic Spin Correlation in Half-Filled 3D Hubbard Model
arxiv-2404-08745.creator: Yu-Feng Song, Youjin Deng, Yuan-Yao He
arxiv-2404-08745.description: Abstract The Hubbard model at temperatures above the Néel transition, despite being a paramagnet, can exhibit rich physics due to the interplay of Fermi surface, on-site interaction U U and thermal fluctuations. Nevertheless, the understanding of the crossover physics remains only at a qualitative level, because of the intrinsically smooth behavior.

arxiv-2409-12493.title: ConvexECG: Lightweight and Explainable Neural Networks for Personalized, Continuous Cardiac Monitoring Thanks: † \dagger These authors contributed equally to this work. This work was supported in part by the National Science Foundation (NSF) under Grant DMS-2134248 and the CAREER Award Grant CCF-223
arxiv-2409-12493.creator: Rayan Ansari †, John Cao †, Sabyasachi Bandyopadhyay, Sanjiv M. Narayan, Albert J. Rogers, Mert Pilanci
arxiv-2409-12493.description: Abstract We present ConvexECG, an explainable and resource-efficient method for reconstructing six-lead electrocardiograms (ECG) from single-lead data, aimed at advancing personalized and continuous cardiac monitoring. ConvexECG leverages a convex reformulation of a two-layer ReLU neural network, enabling the potential for efficient training and deployment in resource constrained environments, while also having deterministic and explainable behavior.

arxiv-2501-03195.title: Parking on the Random Recursive Tree
arxiv-2501-03195.creator: Alice Contat, Lucile Laulin
arxiv-2501-03195.description: Abstract We study the parking process on the random recursive tree. We first prove that although the random recursive tree has a non-degenerate Benjamini–Schramm limit, the phase transition for the parking process appears at density 0 0 . We then identify the critical window for appearance of a positive flux of cars with high probability.

arxiv-2502-14664.title: Status of ℤ 3 \mathbb{Z}_{3} -NMSSM featuring a light bino-dominated LSP and a light singlet-like scalar under the LZ experiment
arxiv-2502-14664.creator: Guangning Ban
arxiv-2502-14664.description: Abstract In the presence of a light singlet-like scalar, the bino-dominated dark matter (DM) candidate in the ℤ 3 \mathbb{Z}_{3} -symmetric next-to-minimal supersymmetric standard model ( ℤ 3 \mathbb{Z}_{3} -NMSSM) exhibits notable deviations from its counterpart in the minimal supersymmetric standard model (MSSM), both in terms of its inherent properties and the mechanisms determining its relic abundance and detection prospects.

arxiv-2506-16604.title: Complete systems of solutions, transmutations and Darboux transform for Sturm-Liouville equations in impedance form
arxiv-2506-16604.creator: Víctor A. Vicente-Benítez
arxiv-2506-16604.description: Abstract We present the construction of a complete system of functions associated with the Sturm–Liouville equation in impedance form on a finite interval I I , given an impedance function a ∈ L 2 ​ ( I ) a\in L^{2}(I) .

arxiv-2511-11227.title: Efficient circuits for leaf-separable state preparation
arxiv-2511-11227.creator: Sunil Vittal, Anthony Wilkie, Nika Rastegari, Mostafa Atallah, Rebekah Herrman
arxiv-2511-11227.description: Abstract Efficient state preparation is a challenging and important problem in quantum computing. In this work, we present a recursive state preparation algorithm that combines logarithmic-depth Dicke state circuits with Hamming weight encoders for efficiently preparing “leaf-separable” quantum states. The algorithm is built on binary partition trees, generalized weight distribution blocks (gWDBs), and leaf-level encoders.

britannica-1911-mcduffie-george.title: McDuffie, George (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-mcduffie-george.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mcduffie-george.description: Article 'McDuffie, George' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born in Columbia county, Georgia. He Was admitted to the bar in 1814, and served in the South Carolina General Assembly in 1818–1821, and in the national House of Representatives in 1821–1834. In 1821 he published a pamphlet in which strict construction and states’ rights were strongly denounced; yet in 1832 there were few more uncompromising nullificationists.

cia-0000118930.creator: Central Intelligence Agency
cia-0000118930.source: Internet Archive — CIA Reading Room mirror
cia-0000118930.description: Declassified CIA document 0000118930, dated 3 August 1965. Subject: THE SEPTEMBER 15TH STATEMENT ON THE DOMINICAN REPUBLIC BY THE HONORABLE J. WILL.

europmc-pmc6469166.title: Phages for Phage Therapy: Isolation, Characterization, and Host Range Breadth.
europmc-pmc6469166.creator: Hyman P.
europmc-pmc6469166.description: For a bacteriophage to be useful for phage therapy it must be both isolated from the environment and shown to have certain characteristics beyond just killing strains of the target bacterial pathogen. These include desirable characteristics such as a relatively broad host range...

pmc-10738062.title: DOES INTERNET USE PROMOTE OLDER ADULTS’ SELF-PERCEPTION OF AGING: SEPARATING WITHIN- AND BETWEEN-PERSON EFFECTS
pmc-10738062.creator: Kun Wang, Danan Gu
pmc-10738062.description: Previous longitudinal studies indicate a positive causal association between older adults’ Internet use and self-perception of aging (SPA). However, it is unclear whether this positive effect is truly due to the lagged within-person changes in Internet use or due to some stable, trait-like between-person differences.

pmc-10795496.title: Point Cloud Completion of Plant Leaves under Occlusion Conditions Based on Deep Learning
pmc-10795496.creator: Haibo Chen, Shengbo Liu, Congyue Wang, Chaofeng Wang, Kangye Gong, Yuanhong Li, Yubin Lan
pmc-10795496.description: The utilization of 3-dimensional point cloud technology for non-invasive measurement of plant phenotypic parameters can furnish important data for plant breeding, agricultural production, and diverse research applications. Nevertheless, the utilization of depth sensors and other tools for capturing plant point clouds often results in missing and incomplete data due to the limitations of 2.5D imaging features and leaf occlusion.

pmc-11356728.title: A Systematic Review of Modeling and Simulation for Precision Diamond Wire Sawing of Monocrystalline Silicon
pmc-11356728.creator: Ansheng Li, Hongyan Wang, Shunchang Hu, Yu Zhou, Jinguang Du, Lianqing Ji, Wuyi Ming, Massimo Cazzanelli
pmc-11356728.description: Precision processing of monocrystalline silicon presents significant challenges due to its unique crystal structure and chemical properties. Effective modeling and simulation are essential for advancing the understanding of the manufacturing process, optimizing design, and refining production parameters to enhance product quality and performance.

pmc-11428074.title: Between animal research and animal welfare: Analysing the openness practices of UK Named Veterinary Surgeons
pmc-11428074.creator: Renelle McGlacken, Pru Hobson-West
pmc-11428074.description: The use of animals as scientific models is argued to be crucial for producing new scientific and medical knowledge and clinical treatments. However, animal research continues to raise socio-ethical concerns. In recent years, there has been a push for openness amongst the life science community, with the aim of increasing the transparency of animal research to wider publics.

pmc-11450932.title: Cardiometabolic Diseases and Depression
pmc-11450932.creator: Seong Hwan Kim, Jang Young Kim, Kwang Kon Koh
pmc-11450932.description: Corresponding Author Cardiovascular disease (CVD) and depression are leading causes of disability worldwide and a major component of health care expenditures due to the increased use of health care services.1 In particular, CardioMetabolic Syndrome (C-MetS) is rapidly increasing and a major cause for CVD.

pmc-11604243.title: Treat the Patient as a Whole, Not Just the Laboratory Findings: A Case of Contaminated Blood Cultures With Subsequent Iatrogenic Complications
pmc-11604243.creator: Christ Ordookhanian, Ryan F Amidon, Max Slosarski, Paul Kaloostian
pmc-11604243.description: Sepsis is a serious condition involving life-threatening infection-driven immune response and organ dysfunction. In the emergency department (ED), patients at high risk for sepsis or those with suspected sepsis are managed with a standardized protocol which includes empiric broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy pending blood culture results and susceptibilities, if applicable.

pmc-11727148.title: Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Atrial Fibrillation: The Need for a Strong Pharmacological Approach
pmc-11727148.creator: Alfredo Mauriello, Adriana Correra, Riccardo Molinari, Gerardo Elia Del Vecchio, Viviana Tessitore, Antonello D’Andrea, Vincenzo Russo, Guilhian Leipnitz, André Quincozes-Santos
pmc-11727148.description: Despite great progress in treating atrial fibrillation (AF), especially with the development of increasingly effective invasive techniques for AF ablation, many unanswered questions remain regarding the pathogenic mechanism of the arrhythmia and its prevention methods. The development of AF is based on anatomical and functional alterations in the cardiomyocyte resulting from altered ionic fluxes and cardiomyocyte electrophysiology.

pmc-12452894.title: Modeling human retinal ganglion cell axonal outgrowth, development, and pathology using pluripotent stem cell–based microfluidic platforms
pmc-12452894.creator: Cátia Gomes, Kang-Chieh Huang, Sailee S. Lavekar, Jade Harkin, Carson G. Prosser, Yue Fang, Claire Kalem, Adrian Oblak, Chi Zhang, Jason S. Meyer
pmc-12452894.description: SignificanceRetinal ganglion cells (RGCs) are highly compartmentalized cells, with several features unique to axons. Previous studies have explored RGCs derived from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs), with applications for research in human retinogenesis and the in vitro modeling of RGC neurodegeneration.

pmc-12561561.title: Time Delay and Frequency Analysis of Remote Microphones
pmc-12561561.creator: Elena Andreatta, Igor Caregnato, Antonio Selmo, Andrea Gulli, Marius George Onofrei, Eva Orzan, Andrea Ciorba
pmc-12561561.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: A.BA.CO. is a speech-to-text captioning system developed for school classrooms. The system uses remote microphones to capture the teacher’s speech without background noise. Under this setup, an issue of signal latency arises for students wearing hearing aids (HAs) or cochlear implants (CIs), whose latency is different from that of the remote microphones and may require the development of a temporal coupling solution.

pmc-12581602.title: Impact of volume-based procurement policy on coronary stent use in tianjin: interrupted time series analysis
pmc-12581602.creator: Zhao Yang, Liangyu Ni, Wei Zhao, Yuxi Li, Yongyi Wu, Qiyun Zhu, Linlin Da, Weijia Liu, Qi Zhang, Jianping Li, Bin Jiang
pmc-12581602.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to analyze the impact of China’s centralized volume-based procurement policy on the procurement and utilization of coronary stents in Tianjin from 2019 to 2021.MethodsAn interrupted time-series design was used to assess monthly procurement data of coronary stents and balloons in Tianjin from January 2019 to December 2021.

pmc-12672515.title: Editorial: Stem cell therapy for hereditary neuromuscular diseases
pmc-12672515.creator: Katsumasa Goto, Atsushi Asakura
pmc-12672515.description: e and play a crucial role in this regenerative process (Asakura et al., 2002). Satellite cells exhibit differentiation potential toward adipocytes, osteocytes, fibroblasts, and other cell types in vitro or under specific pathological conditions (Asakura et al., 2001). However, the primary fate of differentiation in normal muscle regeneration is skeletal muscle cells.

pmc-13124585.title: Endoscopic endonasal resection of neurohypophyseal granular cell tumor: a case report and review of 88 published cases
pmc-13124585.creator: Yahui Zhang, Ming-chen Xie, Hao Han, Xun Xie, Wenyue Zhang, Jianhua Cheng, Jian Xu
pmc-13124585.description: BackgroundGranular cell tumor (GCT) of the neurohypophysis is a rare tumor originating from the posterior pituitary/infundibulum, classified as WHO grade I. Due to its imaging characteristics being highly similar to those of common sellar lesions, diagnosis typically relies on histopathology and immunohistochemistry.Case presentationA 43-year-old male presented with a one-month history of pulsatile temporal headaches without significant visual complaints.

pmc-13179187.title: Eugenol from Syzygium aromaticum enhances longevity and proteostasis in aged yeast
pmc-13179187.creator: Suchanya Suesattayapirom, Tachaporn Kanhachai, Anjana Puttapong, Onnicha Pongwattanakewin, Phannarai Prapussorn, Yaowarin Nakornpakdee, Laran T. Jensen, Amornrat Naranuntarat Jensen
pmc-13179187.description: Clove (Syzygium aromaticum) extracts promote longevity in several model systems, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms responsible for the pro-longevity remain poorly defined. This study utilized a Saccharomyces cerevisiae model to investigate how clove extracts modulate two primary hallmarks of cellular aging: oxidative damage and the decline of protein quality control systems.

pmc-13374814.title: Transperineal versus transrectal prostate biopsy: Aligning Indian practice with emerging evidence
pmc-13374814.creator: Mohammed Omar Khan
pmc-13374814.description: d transrectal (TR) biopsy approaches in a Bayesian meta-analytic framework.[1] The main finding was a 62% reduction in the infectious complications with the TP approach. Notably, this benefit was observed despite the omission of antibiotic prophylaxis in the TP arms, whereas the TR groups received targeted prophylaxis based on rectal swab cultures.

pmc-13458282.title: New Insights Into the Phytochemical Composition and Biological Potential of Leaf Extracts From Algerian Autochthonous Vitis vinifera L.
pmc-13458282.creator: Radhia Belmanaa, Azzeddine Zeraib, Ziane Laiadi, Ahmed Simozrag, Khadra Afaf Bendrihem, Ayomide Victor Atoki, Mohammed Messaoudi
pmc-13458282.description: Vitis vinifera leaves are abundant by‐products of the grape industry, often discarded as agricultural waste. This study explores the in vitro and in silico antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antibacterial properties of hydromethanolic crude extracts from grapevine leaves from five local grapevine varieties in Algeria (Chikki, Azorith‐fereinguel, Bezoul El‐khadem d'Algérie, Amesski El Hamma, and Hasram).

pmc-13514663.title: GANCIU—Geospatial Analysis with Neural Classification and Image Understanding
pmc-13514663.creator: Amedeo Ganciu, Giovannangela Ricci, Margherita Solci
pmc-13514663.description: Accurate and up-to-date knowledge of land use and land cover represents one of the central challenges in spatial planning and landscape sciences. In this context, the present work introduces GANCIU (Geospatial Analysis with Neural Classification and Image Understanding), an original hybrid pipeline for the automatic extraction of man-made infrastructure from high-resolution satellite imagery.

pmc-13523522.title: Genome-wide identification and salt stress-induced expression analysis of the NHX gene family in peanut (Arachis hypogaea L.)
pmc-13523522.creator: Xuhong Zhao, Dongwei Cui, Na Chen, Xiao Jiang, Lijuan Pan, Jing Xu, Xiangzhen Yin, Junqing Ma, Feifei Wan, Xiaoli Zhang, Xiaoyuan Chi
pmc-13523522.description: BackgroundPeanut (Arachis hypogaea L.) is a prominent legume and oilseed crop cultivated globally for its economic significance and nutritional value. With the growing demand for edible oil and protein, peanut cultivation needs to be expanded into salinized land. However, salt stress in such soils severely limits peanut growth and productivity.
